df8b6b8b886555c4.what: Compares three phonon-transport models (Debye approximation up to a DFT-based first-principles framework) for thin-film buffer and transition layers in AlGaN HEMT stacks, including alloy scattering and grain/film-boundary scattering fitted to TDTR thermal conductivity data.
df8b6b8b886555c4.why: Thermal transport in the thin-film layers of modern HEMT designs is hard to model reliably, especially for non-ideal polycrystalline films.
df8b6b8b886555c4.how: Models with DFT harmonic and anharmonic properties, alloy scattering, and boundary scattering fitted to TDTR data; emphasis on a procedure for extracting intrinsic Umklapp-dominated properties.
df8b6b8b886555c4.impact: Directly relevant to the GaN/AlGaN HEMT multiscale thermal modeling project: gives a benchmark of model fidelity (first-principles model performs best) and a procedure for intrinsic vs. extrinsic scattering that could be compared against the MLIP-to-BTE pipeline.

47e12668866b86ef.what: Compares an EAM potential with the NequIP foundational potential on static and fatigue-driven emergent properties. NequIP predicts an intrinsic stacking fault energy about 7 times lower than EAM and far more plastic deformation under fatigue cycling of a nanoscale crack.
47e12668866b86ef.why: Foundational MLIPs are validated on equilibrium states, which does not guarantee correct emergent behavior in large-scale MD.
47e12668866b86ef.how: Fatigue loading of a Griffith-crack-like nanoscale flaw, per-atom energy distributions after loading; also documents memory-related crashes and silent extrapolation.
47e12668866b86ef.impact: Relevant to MLIP failure modes across the InGaAs (DeePMD vs MACE), GaN/AlGaN and BAs projects: a reminder that equilibrium accuracy does not ensure far-from-equilibrium reliability, and that silent extrapolation needs checking. Thermal transport is not studied.

96c9456506139642.what: Shows that tuning precursor loading and oxygen partial pressure in direct liquid injection CVD switches epitaxial Bi4Ti3O12 films from 2D growth to dislocation-mediated chiral spiral growth, with 135% higher local vertical piezoresponse and lower switching bias (from ±20 to ±5 V).
96c9456506139642.why: Aurivillius ferroelectrics have mainly in-plane polarization, limiting vertical device integration; defect topology control through growth mode is unexplored.
96c9456506139642.how: CVD growth, PFM, HAADF-STEM displacement mapping and DFT.
96c9456506139642.impact: Low relevance. Mostly experimental growth work with no thermal transport; only a loose link to the BaTiO3 dislocation project through oxide dislocation structure.

b79f031522497d2d.what: Presents Perfumer, an LLM-based agentic framework coupling Quantum ESPRESSO with a pre-relaxation model (2.75-fold overall speedup) and a graph-neural-network band predictor (median MAE 0.157 eV on 2,607 test materials, trained on 125,153 band structures).
b79f031522497d2d.why: First-principles relaxation and band calculations need substantial computation and expertise.
b79f031522497d2d.how: Agent turns natural-language requests into relaxation-to-band workflows; periodic GNN with latent Hermitian spectral head predicts 12 band energies at any wavevector in about 97 ms on two CPU cores.
b79f031522497d2d.impact: Relevant to the interest in agents for automated first-principles workflows; the relax-then-refine pattern could inform automating VASP/phonopy or MLPhonon workflows. It covers electronic bands, not phonons or thermal transport.

388a96570810e4bf.what: Presents AdsNet, an equivariant GNN predicting adsorption energies in one forward pass from a local graph of the adsorbate and nearby surface atoms (energy RMSE 0.032 eV, force RMSE 0.047 eV/A), with atom-wise energy decomposition.
388a96570810e4bf.why: Catalyst screening needs adsorption energy prediction that is fast and geometry-sensitive; full-graph MLIPs are slow and coordination-based models are insensitive.
388a96570810e4bf.how: Message passing with scalar and vector features, trained on AdsTraj (33,920 DFT structures, 26 transition metals, 6 adsorbates); relaxation via projected gradient descent with line search.
388a96570810e4bf.impact: Low relevance to the thermal projects (catalysis). The atom-wise energy decomposition for interpretability is a mildly interesting idea for MLIP interpretability work.

7bb928c5203753e0.what: First-principles comparison of TcB2 (20 GPa), Tc2B and Tc3B: mechanical, electronic, optical properties and electron-phonon-coupling superconductivity (Tc of 24.92, 11.07 and 15.12 K with μ* = 0.10).
7bb928c5203753e0.why: Phonon-mediated superconductivity in transition-metal borides depends on the balance of d-states, metal-boron bonding and lattice vibrations.
7bb928c5203753e0.how: DFT-based calculations of electronic structure, spin-orbit coupling, optical response and electron-phonon coupling.
7bb928c5203753e0.impact: Low relevance. Standard DFT/EPC study of superconducting borides, not thermal transport in the reader's semiconductors or interfaces.

2a047a17bf7803c0.what: High-throughput screening of equimolar and non-equimolar high-entropy carbides of Ti, Zr, Hf, V, Nb and Ta, using the MACE foundation model and DeePMD trained on ab initio data to predict stable compositions.
2a047a17bf7803c0.why: The composition space of high-entropy ceramics is too large to test experimentally or with ab initio calculations.
2a047a17bf7803c0.how: MACE and DeePMD potentials screen thousands of compositions; stable candidates are proposed for synthesis. Details of validation are not stated in the abstract.
2a047a17bf7803c0.impact: Moderate-to-low relevance: uses MACE and DeePMD as in the InGaAs project, so it is a practical example of using both for screening, but it targets phase stability rather than thermal transport.

8bb61bfd8abaede4.what: Measures electrical and thermal conductivity of CrMnFeCoNi after high-pressure torsion; thermal conductivity rises from 10.3 to 14.4 W/m/K, with Wiedemann-Franz analysis giving about 5% more electron and about 100% more phonon transport.
8bb61bfd8abaede4.why: To understand how defects and nanostructuring affect electron and phonon transport in a high-entropy alloy.
8bb61bfd8abaede4.how: Severe plastic deformation (up to 4 turns), conductivity, specific heat and thermal expansion measurements, Cahill-Pohl comparison; phonon MFP about 0.6-1.1 nm.
8bb61bfd8abaede4.impact: Mostly experimental, so low priority. The finding that disorder changes near-minimum-limit transport (hypothesized short-range ordering) is a mechanism a computational study could test, but it is not tied to a current project.

1e4638f32dc0f6b8.what: Review of AI-assisted thermoreflectance imaging: high-throughput data processing, visualization of interfacial thermal transport and nonintrusive subsurface analysis, with outlooks on spectral mapping of heat carriers, 3D property mapping and AI-agentic experimental design.
1e4638f32dc0f6b8.why: Shrinking, heterogeneous electronics need local mapping of thermal properties, but throughput vs. accuracy and multi-parameter extraction remain challenging.
1e4638f32dc0f6b8.how: Literature review of pump-probe and wide-field thermoreflectance techniques combined with AI methods.
1e4638f32dc0f6b8.impact: Useful background for the measurement side of the GaN/Al2O3 interface and HEMT projects (what TDTR-type data may constrain models), and for electronics thermal characterization trends. Experimental/review focus, not a computational method.

9a2ac20987253996.what: Identifies Boson peaks in the low-temperature heat capacity of many phase-change materials and chalcogenide GeSeTe glasses, and models them as hybridization of transverse acoustic phonons with quasi-localized modes.
9a2ac20987253996.why: Fast crystallization of PCMs hinders conventional characterization; Boson peaks offer another route and a dataset on vibrational and thermodynamic properties.
9a2ac20987253996.how: Heat capacity and heat flow measurements; correlation of mean Einstein temperature with Debye temperature and excess-mode coefficient.
9a2ac20987253996.impact: Low relevance to the current crystalline-semiconductor and interface projects; only a loose link via vibrational modes in disordered systems.

53b3324f3523df3f.what: Formulates a two-field Gibbs theory of quaternionic orientational order, with a crystal field and a glass field defined as the frozen part of orientational holonomy, treating disclinations and dislocations via curvature and torsion.
53b3324f3523df3f.why: To describe glass formation and defect condensation with a thermodynamic functional that separates glass from liquid and from defect density.
53b3324f3523df3f.how: Theoretical construction of a Gibbs functional with competing saddles; the order of transition follows from the quartic coupling matrix. Numerical results are not stated in the abstract.
53b3324f3523df3f.impact: Low relevance. Abstract field theory of defects and glass formation, with no phonon or thermal transport link to the reader's projects.

1dfbf0fe22186261.what: Raman study of (Bi1-xSbx)2Te3 at ambient and high pressure; derives composition-dependent force constants (harmonic approximation) and Grüneisen parameters, with a maximum average Grüneisen parameter at BST-07 linked via Slack's equation to optimal ZT.
1dfbf0fe22186261.why: To connect composition, lattice dynamics and thermal transport and find the microscopic origin of thermoelectric optimization.
1dfbf0fe22186261.how: Raman spectroscopy under pressure, equation of state and bulk modulus from earlier reports, Slack's equation.
1dfbf0fe22186261.impact: Mostly experimental with a lattice-dynamics angle; the Grüneisen/anharmonicity data could serve as validation targets for phonon calculations, but it is not tied to a current project.

4d826c1ec30c7528.what: Ab initio many-body study of chiral phonons in tellurium: rotational symmetries impose pseudoangular-momentum selection rules on phonon-phonon scattering, preserving circular polarization up to 600 K while lifetimes drop sharply.
4d826c1ec30c7528.why: It is poorly understood how chiral phonons survive anharmonic phonon-phonon interactions at finite temperature.
4d826c1ec30c7528.how: Ab initio anharmonic many-body approach; angular momentum generated by a thermal gradient is shown to be governed by lifetimes rather than chirality (decreasing about two orders of magnitude from 10 to 600 K).
4d826c1ec30c7528.impact: Relevant theory for anharmonic phonon scattering and symmetry selection rules in lattice dynamics (the BTE phonon-property side of the projects) and possibly for the BaTiO3 phonon direction asymmetry work, though the material and focus differ.

449b6e796caeff27.what: GitHub repository for Allegro, a code for building highly scalable E(3)-equivariant interatomic potentials (PyTorch; topics include MD and force fields).
449b6e796caeff27.why: Not stated beyond the repository description: scalable equivariant MLIPs for atomistic simulation.
449b6e796caeff27.how: Python/PyTorch code from the mir-group; further details are not stated in the description.
449b6e796caeff27.impact: An open-source MLIP framework that is a candidate alternative to DeePMD-kit and MACE for the InGaAs, GaN/AlGaN and BAs projects, especially for large-scale MD and thermal conductivity via MD.

ad74da2925f8a3d1.what: Advanced Thermal Solutions introduced the ArctiQ NIVIS series of cold plates for liquid cooling of AMD SP5 platform processors for AI, HPC and server CPUs.
ad74da2925f8a3d1.why: Rising power in AI/HPC server processors requires direct-contact liquid cooling.
ad74da2925f8a3d1.how: Direct-contact cold plates; further specifications are not stated in the excerpt.
ad74da2925f8a3d1.impact: Low relevance to the research projects; a small data point on liquid-cooling trends for AI/HPC hardware relevant to electronics thermal management industry awareness.
